description_en: Timeout in milliseconds for a mid-session skills resync when CLAUDE_CODE_SYNC_SKILLS is set (default: 30000). Bounds the download triggered when the host requests a skill reload during the session. When exceeded, the resync stops and remaining downloads continue in the background
description_ja: CLAUDE_CODE_SYNC_SKILLSが有効な場合の、セッション中におけるスキルの再同期タイムアウトをミリ秒単位で設定します(デフォルトは30000)。
